opening.argument: The sampled frames center on a Firozabad police complaint portal launched on blockchain and describe the process as transparent. That reporting context is stronger than the title's promotional invitation to join forsage.io to earn. The title links participation with income, but the available material does not establish a payment requirement, referral condition, guaranteed return, or deceptive behavior. Nor do the frames show a concrete request to send money or private data. Taken together, the promotional title and the reporting-focused frames support an educational or operational reading rather than a finding of scam solicitation.
